page.running_head: P. VOET / Nec dignum matre, nec Lacedæmonio.

main_text.p: c.qui potest c ab Imperatoribus.Consentiunt hic etiam canones, qui multis in locis, defensionem patriæ, ut & aliorum, c. fortitudo. 23.in genere commendant.

quæst. 3. & c. si nullam.Neque sacra pagina contradicitur, quæ exemplo Goliathi c.omnium, 23. quæst. 5.ac Davidis pro incolumitate Israëlitici exercitus dimicantis, demonstrare voluit, addità forma & modo indicendi duelli, talem monomachiam, bono publico susceptam, illicitam non esse. 1. Sam. 17.Neque enim in tali genere certaminis ullum est delictum aut peccatum. Su-scipitur auctoritate publicâ lic[?] disponente, aut permittente. Aggreditur qui decertat, communem reipublicæ hostem ex condicto. Quem ut licitè interimit, ita non aggreditur privatæ causâ vindictæ, sed publicæ gratiâ utilitatis.

page.notes: Printed text runs off the right edge of this part; the continuation of the last paragraph is on the next part of the page. Text reads as printed; long s was normalised to s. The word after "publicâ" is printed as "lic" at the line end, and the rest of the word is not legible on this part; it is marked [?]. The first word of the page is cut at the left edge of the scan. Its initial letter reads as long s and is transcribed as s.
